planets.name: TOI-5573 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5573 with a 8.8-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5573 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5573. Its orbit and size follow Fernandes et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
